dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: What's going on? What do you mean there's a problem you all "can't solve"?

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: Why, yes there is. I'm the new port supervisor here. But ever since I installed that cutting-edge kuuvahki conveyor belt on the docks, it's been breaking down every other day!

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: If it doesn't get jammed, then something'll come loose, and if neither of those, then it's the power supply having issues!

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: I thought there was something wrong with the machine I bought, so I paid a hefty sum to get a master to fix it. But he's been looking at it for three days, and he still can't tell me what the problem is!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then...

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: *sigh* How much longer can a simple repair take...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe it's not a technical issue.

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: So, what, it's been sabotaged? Come now, don't spout such nonsense. The higher-ups of the merchant guild have vowed to use this as an opportunity to promote the automatization of kuuvahki machinery!

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: If this was a place under the Tsaritsa's jurisdiction, any Harbinger would have solved the problem with a single order.

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: *sigh* If it weren't for my dad forcing me to return and take up this post... I'd still be working on the latest kinetic mechanisms at the Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya...

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: That'd be a whole lot easier than dealing with this mess...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like this new tech isn't all it's cracked up to be.

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: *sigh* You sound just like that band of stubborn old dockworkers.

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: The future is now! Technology advances, and mankind must have faith!
